verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents image-to-video generation through its `heygen-video-1` model, which turns text or an image into 5–30 s clips. Photo Avatars animate a single still image of a person. Aspect ratio can auto-match the source image, which helps keep framing. However, nothing explicitly documents that the subject and composition are preserved in the generated motion. missing for 10: explicit documentation of subject/composition fidelity for image-to-video, hands-on or independent corroboration of image animation quality.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved

citations.quote: text or image to 5–30 s clips with turbo/quality enhancement
set `aspect_ratio: "auto"` (matches the source footage or image, falling back to `16:9`)
A Photo Avatar is created from a single still image of a person. HeyGen animates the face, syncs lip movements to your script
